name: decideChangeOrder
shortDescription: Records a decision for a ChangeOrder, updating project balance, materializing order lines, and notifying the customer.
description:
Overview

This function records a decision (approve/reject) on a ChangeOrder. If approved, it updates the associated Project's balanceDue, materializes ChangeOrderLineItems into WorkOrder scope or ProductOrderLineItems, and sends an email notification to the Customer. It ensures that WorkOrder.total remains unchanged to reflect installer pay.

Intended use

This function is intended to be called by a UI when an authorized user (e.g., project manager, administrator) makes a decision on a ChangeOrder. It orchestrates the necessary updates across multiple entities and communicates the outcome to the customer. It takes the ChangeOrder ID and the decision (approved/rejected) as parameters.

Logic

  1. Retrieve the ChangeOrder using the provided ID.
  2. If the ChangeOrder has already been decided, return a 409 conflict error.
  3. Record the decision (approved/rejected) on the ChangeOrder and the user who made the decision.
  4. If the decision is 'approved':
    1. Retrieve the associated Project.
    2. Recalculate Project.balanceDue by adding the approved ChangeOrder's gross sale and approved change amounts (including tax) and subtracting any depositReceived, ensuring consistency with recordFinalPayment logic to avoid double-counting.
    3. For each ChangeOrderLineItem of type 'Labor', update the scope of the associated WorkOrder.
    4. For each ChangeOrderLineItem of type 'Product', create a ProductOrderLineItem under a new or existing draft, vendor-less ProductOrder (holding order).
    5. Retrieve the Customer associated with the Project.
    6. Send an email Communication to the Customer notifying them of the approved ChangeOrder and the updated project balance.
  5. If the decision is 'rejected':
    1. Send an email Communication to the Customer notifying them of the rejected ChangeOrder.
  6. Save all modified entities.
  7. Return the updated ChangeOrder status.

Entities

  • ChangeOrder
  • ChangeOrderLineItem
  • Project
  • LineItem
  • ProductOrder
  • ProductOrderLineItem
  • Customer
  • Communication
